notes: Furnished starter lots. Apply in order: floors (World.set_floor_rect_raw), walls (World.set_wall_line, type wall/fence), objects (World.place_object def/tile/rot; doors/windows are wall-mounted objects whose rot picks the tile edge: 0=N 1=E 2=S 3=W), then spawn tiles. Tiles are absolute on the default 32x24 lot.

small.label: Starter Studio
small.description: A cosy one-room flat with a bathroom nook and a tiny garden. Good for one or two folk.

medium.label: Family Home
medium.description: Two bedrooms, kitchen-diner, bathroom, living room, laundry corner and a garden. Fits a small family.

large.label: Grand Estate
large.description: Three bedrooms, two bathrooms, big kitchen with bar, living room with fireplace, studio, gym corner, and a yard with garden, pond, grill and hot tub.

cafe.label: Moss & Mug Cafe
cafe.description: A warm cafe by day, a lively bar by night: a long counter, stools, tables and a dance floor.

gym.label: Ironleaf Gym
gym.description: Treadmills, free weights, mats and mirrors. Burns energy, builds fitness.

library.label: Hollow Oak Library
library.description: Rows of bookcases, quiet desks, computers and a terminal. A calm place to read, write and study.

market.label: Greenbarrow Market
market.description: Grocery coolers, vending machines and a checkout. Buy groceries to stock the home fridge.

office.label: Brightline Offices
office.description: Open-plan computers, a terminal bank, meeting tables and a coffee station. Three storeys with a lift and an archive in the basement.

school.label: Larkfield School
school.description: Rows of desks, bookcases and a computer lab. Open on school days.

park.label: Willow Green Park
park.description: Benches, a fishing pond, grills and picnic tables, garden plots and plenty of fresh air.

works.label: Ironbridge Works
works.description: A factory floor, a warehouse, a motor bay and a control room under one roof, with a building yard out front. Work happens here at all hours.

shelter.label: Fernwood Night Shelter
shelter.description: The council's dorm for people with nowhere to sleep: a bunk, a shower and a locker for a few nights a week. No food is served.

bank.label: Greenbarrow Savings Bank
bank.description: A public hall with the teller counter, a loans office, and behind them the back office and the vault.
